subject: Project Kestrel kickoff: CFQ classification guardrail
body:
Hi Ivo,

Kicking off the compositional query-understanding effort — we're tracking this internally as Project Kestrel, so please use that tag in docs and standup notes. Base is our open-source CFQ classification work: convert CFQ into a sentence-pair classification task and train models with structure annotations, which measurably improves compositional generalization.

Why data-platforms cares: our query-understanding services fail on exactly the compositional patterns CFQ measures. A classifier that reliably scores query/parse pairs becomes a guardrail in front of the semantic parser.

Milestones: datasets built by mid-March (including the model-negative variants, which need CFQ baseline beam outputs), trained classifiers with structure annotations by mid-April, integration recommendation by the 5/25 end of window.

Staffing and compute by end of Feb?

Dmitri
